title: Zerogotchi
summary: Wi-Fi lab auditing and GPS wardriving for the Cardputer Zero.
description: Use Auto or targeted Attack modes for authorized lab auditing with a compatible USB Wi-Fi adapter. Save WPA capture results locally or submit usable hashes to OnlineHashCrack. Wardriving uses a GNSS HAT for GPS-tagged Wi-Fi observations, with optional WiGLE upload. The foreground app opens from the stock launcher. Privileged radio access requires the Cardputer user's password.
